top_signals.title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering
top_signals.summary: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are helping Russia circumvent existing financial restrictions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stocks Rise as Investors Shrug Off Nvidia Probe; Trump Says Iran Strikes Unlikely
top_signals.summary: US equity futures rise following the S&P 500’s worst week since April 2025, despite a sharp drop in Nvidia. The chip giant launches an investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. President Trump says it's "highly unlikely," while Secretary of State Marco Rubio plays down any progress in  peace negotiations. Ella Gude of BNY joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss investors' caution after the latest AI rout. (Source: Bloomberg)
